outgoing.name: American Civil War
outgoing.excerpt: The reservoir is named for explorer John Wesley Powell, a one-armed American Civil War veteran who explored the river via three wooden boats in 1869.

outgoing.name: Fishing
outgoing.excerpt: Recreational activities include boating, fishing, waterskiing, jet-skiing, and hiking.
